name: minimum_nomic
description: Minimum Nomic bench: three language models play a self-amending game with nine changeable rules, no goal and no termination condition, while a fourth acts as game master. Runnable scripts, not MCP tools — a game is started from the command line and its record is analysed, audited and mutation-tested afterwards. The post-game analysis is a fixed four-stage procedure: free scoring, scoring under the analysts' own distilled standards, analyst-proposed measures run as code, and repeatability plus mutation.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
